about: The looks: film stocks and movie grades in the Print model, each with its own tone, colour and texture. Built by scripts/filmlooks.py; exported with scripts/print-look.py export-swift. Keys left out inherit from Print. grey = display luminance of 18% grey; slope = log-log contrast below the shoulder; shoulder = how hard highlights turn; white/floor = display white and black; printer/crossover = [red, blue] or [red, green, blue] log-exposure offsets (+ = less of that colour) / [red, blue] gamma splits; interlayer = saturation; channel_mix = 3x3 scene RGB mix (rows normalised to 1); crosstalk = 0..1 of print-dye density coupling; grain = density std at 4032 px; shadow_tint/highlight_tint = split toning, offsets on the encoded print output weighted (1-Y)^2 / Y^2 (made luminance-neutral by filmlooks.py). Looks stay far apart: nearest-neighbour mean ΔE (Oklab) >= 0.06 on the test images, Print included.

desert.name: Desert
desert.about: A desert epic: warm ochre and sand, low saturation, soft lifted blacks and a long, gentle highlight roll-off. No teal.

pastel.name: Pastel
pastel.about: A storybook grade: high key and soft, candy pinks, butter yellows and mint, warm cream whites.

amber.name: Amber Haze
amber.about: Orange fog over a future city: nearly monochrome amber, smoky lifted highlights, a wide warm glow.

sodium.name: Sodium
sodium.about: Streetlight thriller: a green-yellow sodium cast, muddy desaturated shadows, cold skin, low key.

neon.name: Neon Night
neon.about: Neon-lit romance: saturated reds and greens, crushed blacks, green shadows and a strong red glow around lights.

bleach.name: Bleach Bypass
bleach.about: Silver left in the print: hard contrast, drained color, bright metallic highlights and gritty grain.

slide.name: Slide
slide.about: Seventies slide film: rich reds, deep blue skies, dense blacks, warm light and hard contrast.

punch.name: Punch
punch.about: Vivid negative pushed hard: maximum color, bold contrast, bright and clean.

noir.name: Noir
noir.about: Pushed black and white: inky cold-toned blacks, hard contrast, heavy grain and glow.
